texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why Railway?:
I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines) and write about it in public: 110 public repos, published evals, reproducible docs, and a book in progress on human-AI collaboration. Growth content that works on developers is exactly this shape - runnable code and honest write-ups, not marketing copy.

Railway's product is developer experience, and the way to grow it is engineer-grade content: templates people can actually deploy, guides written by someone who operates infrastructure daily. I have taught Solidity curricula, published 50+ items (136 citations, h-index 7), and turned messy frontier practice into docs and courses for a 500+ practitioner community. I would do the same for Railway: build real things on the platform and document them so well they become distribution.
